errors.error_description: Declared a variable using an escaped identifier named \always_comb, which misuses a reserved SystemVerilog keyword as an identifier.
Created a latch by assigning latch_flag only when en is true in an always_comb block, without covering the else path.
Drove the input port addr from inside the module using a procedural assignment.
Drove the same wire md from two separate continuous assignments, causing multiple active drivers on one net.
